mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_items ( order_id, product_id, product_name, price, quantity, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{price}, #{quantity}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id AS orderId, product_id AS productId, product_name AS productName, price, quantity, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM order_items WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id
